name: Razer Battery
description:
Razer wireless device battery in the top panel, deduped by device.

Features:
- Live battery percentage with a charging marker and a theme-adaptive icon
- One entry per device: several sysfs interfaces of the same mouse (wired + dongle) are deduplicated
- Fully asynchronous sysfs reads: a sleeping mouse never blocks the shell
- Sleep-aware: the last known charge is held while the device sleeps
- Instant hotplug reaction via a filesystem watch
- Low-battery notification with a configurable threshold
- Zero overhead when the OpenRazer driver is missing: dormant mode, single '!' in the panel

Requires the OpenRazer kernel driver. If it's missing, the indicator shows '!' and the menu offers a one-command guided install (Arch and derivatives, Fedora, Ubuntu, Debian, openSUSE). Nothing privileged runs inside the shell.

Found a bug? Please report it on GitHub.
